potion_clone_oil.png.prompt:
A single game item icon, one object only, centred, drawn as flat cartoon art.

The object: a small squat oil flask with TWO identical spouts side by side, made of dark lacquered wood with a pale paper seal around the neck; a single drop of golden oil hangs from each spout. The doubled silhouette is the whole point - it must read as 'two of the same thing' at a glance

It is shown at about 40 pixels across in the game, so it must read from its silhouette and its main colour alone:
one bold shape, high contrast, no fine detail, no small parts.
Draw it SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with a little soft shading. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Nothing else in the picture: no hand, no character, no ground, no shadow, no text, no letters, no watermark.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green in the object.
Output 512x512 PNG. Save the image as potion_clone_oil.png in the current directory and report the path.
